items.title: Ignacio Berroa interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 22, 2021 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: I’m going to quote my mentor, my hero, Roy Haynes

ctx.x: You are an absolute delight, Ignacio, I’m telling you.
So that would be my advice to students, and then now whomever is going to see this interview, I’m going to quote my mentor, my hero, Roy Haynes and I’m going to say just © Fillius Jazz Archive -13-

a tiny bad word. Roy Haynes always said, “Don’t forget that somewhere out there you can meet someone who is going to kick your ass.” And that’s how we tell the students. Yeah man, let’s get a great command of our instrument.
